_doc: Củng Tinh Quán's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009), staged by the record pass. The input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py, which merges them into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:cung_tinh. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/cung_tinh.items.json and authored wish d16.

The Twelve Hours.rule: Armillary Array Canon, passive art from layer 4 (authored wish d16): the armillary counts the fight in hours of 5 s, and each ring belongs to the hour it was laid. A ring deals 30 % more within its own hour. When rings of three different hours stand at once, the armillary turns: every ring is refreshed (Earth stacks refreshed and a fresh 12 s ring pulse joins), and each further hour among them adds 6 % more damage and 1 Slowed Time stack on the foe each second.
The Twelve Hours.pending: the loader does not attach a technique's Effects yet (pending word technique-effects); tested via sect_fight / tree_effects

Seen in the Water.rule: Mirror of the Star-Fallen Lake: at the start of a fight you see the first art the foe will use. The first time the foe uses it (the first foe art that lands), you ward it fully (restore all health lost to it) and mark the foe for The Field Turns.
Seen in the Water.approx: the first foe art to land is warded in full via 100 % amount heal instead of matching a specific future art id

Keeper of the Hours.rule: Ring of the Armillary: arrays you lay last a third longer, and the first array you lay in a fight is laid at no cost.
Keeper of the Hours.approx: the first formation art is free via next_art_cost 0; +1/3 array duration extends The Stars Bow by 3 s and adds a 0.14 c / 19 s lingering ring pulse per Ring of the Hour (no duration modifier exists on summon or each_for counters)

The Field Turns.rule: Pole Star Court, full set (2 pieces): while your array field is up and you are Composed, every 4 s the foe gains one Earth stack and its soonest art waits 0.3 s. A foe whose first art the Mirror warded fully takes double damage from your next array art (next formation firing empowers array strikes for 6 s).

Ring Within the Ring.rule: Rings of the Armillary, full set (3 pieces): a Ring of the Hour you lay while your ring (a Field) is up becomes a second ring; while you hold both, the foe is Bound (it cannot flee) and takes your array damage once for each ring every second (+25 % array ring damage while two rings hold).
